```{r}
# -------------------------------------------------
# 0. Packages
# -------------------------------------------------
library(tidyverse)   # read_csv, tibble, etc.
library(caret)       # train / preProcess / dummyVars / createDataPartition
library(nnet)        # method = "nnet"
```

```{r}
# -------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load the raw data and create the target
# -------------------------------------------------
df <- read_csv("~/Lifelines/aletta-regional-year-challenge-2025/data/data_of_interest.csv") %>%
  filter(!is.na(cholesterol_1),
         !is.na(cholesterol_2)) %>%
  mutate(CHOL_2 = cholesterol_2)

```

```{r}
# -------------------------------------------------
# 2. Choose the predictors you really want
# -------------------------------------------------
predictor_vars <- c(
  "age",
  "gender",
  "body_weight_1",
  "body_length_1",
  "longitude",
  "circumference_waist_1",
  "circumference_hip_1",
  "kcal_intake",
  "alcohol_intake",
  "added_sugar",
  "nova_foodintake_1",
  "nova_foodintake_4"
)

df <- df %>% select(all_of(c(predictor_vars, "CHOL_2")))
```

```{r}
# -------------------------------------------------
# 3. Split into train / test (keep the outcome with the splits)
# -------------------------------------------------
set.seed(123)
train_idx <- createDataPartition(df$CHOL_2, p = .8, list = FALSE)
train_raw <- df[train_idx, ]
test_raw  <- df[-train_idx, ]
```

```{r}
# -------------------------------------------------
# 4. Turn character columns into factors (needed for dummyVars)
# -------------------------------------------------
to_factor <- function(x) if (is.character(x)) as.factor(x) else x
train_raw[] <- lapply(train_raw, to_factor)
test_raw[]  <- lapply(test_raw,  to_factor)
```

```{r}
# -------------------------------------------------
# 5. Add an explicit “Missing” level to every factor
# -------------------------------------------------
add_missing_level <- function(dat) {
  fac_cols <- sapply(dat, is.factor)
  dat[fac_cols] <- lapply(dat[fac_cols], function(f) {
    f <- addNA(f)                     # NA becomes a level
    levels(f)[is.na(levels(f))] <- "Missing"
    f
  })
  dat
}
train_raw <- add_missing_level(train_raw)
test_raw  <- add_missing_level(test_raw)
```

```{r}
# -------------------------------------------------
# 6. ---------- PRE‑PROCESSING ----------
# -------------------------------------------------
# 6a. Separate predictors and outcome
train_X <- train_raw %>% select(-CHOL_2)
test_X  <- test_raw  %>% select(-CHOL_2)

# 6b. One-hot encode predictors (factors -> numeric dummies)
dummy_mod <- dummyVars(~ ., data = train_X, fullRank = FALSE)

train_dum <- predict(dummy_mod, newdata = train_X) %>% as.data.frame()
test_dum  <- predict(dummy_mod, newdata = test_X)  %>% as.data.frame()

# 6c. Now preprocess numeric predictors (impute/scale/nzv)
pp_obj <- preProcess(
  train_dum,
  method = c("nzv", "medianImpute", "center", "scale")
)

train_pp <- predict(pp_obj, train_dum)
test_pp  <- predict(pp_obj, test_dum)

# 6d. Reattach outcome
train_enc <- train_pp
test_enc  <- test_pp
train_enc$CHOL_2 <- train_raw$CHOL_2
test_enc$CHOL_2  <- test_raw$CHOL_2
```

```{r}
# -------------------------------------------------
# 7. Train the neural‑net
# -------------------------------------------------
set.seed(123)
nnet_grid <- expand.grid(
  size  = c(1, 5, 50),
  decay = c(0.5, 1e-7)
)

nnet_model <- train(
  CHOL_2 ~ .,
  data        = train_enc,
  method      = "nnet",
  metric      = "RMSE",
  tuneGrid    = nnet_grid,
  trControl   = trainControl(method = "cv", number = 2),
  linout      = TRUE,      # regression
  trace       = TRUE      
)

```

```{r}
# -------------------------------------------------
# 8. Quick sanity‑check on the hold‑out set
# -------------------------------------------------
test_pred <- predict(nnet_model, newdata = test_enc)

rmse_test <- sqrt(mean((test_enc$CHOL_2 - test_pred)^2))
mae_test  <- mean(abs(test_enc$CHOL_2 - test_pred))
r2_test   <- cor(test_enc$CHOL_2, test_pred)^2

cat("\n=== Test‑set performance ===\n")
cat("RMSE :", round(rmse_test, 3), "\n")
cat("MAE  :", round(mae_test, 3), "\n")
cat("R²   :", round(r2_test, 3), "\n")

ggplot(data = tibble(
  observed = test_enc$CHOL_2,
  predicted = test_pred
),
aes(x = observed, y = predicted)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, colour = "#2C3E50") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0,
              colour = "#E74C3C", linetype = "dashed", size = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "Observed vs. Predicted Cholesterol at T1 (Test Set)",
    x = "Observed mmol/L",
    y = "Predicted mmol/L"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)


```
R2 = 0.15

```{r}
# -------------------------------------------------
# 9. Save everything you’ll need for inference
# -------------------------------------------------
saveRDS(nnet_model,   "chol2_nnet_model.rds")
saveRDS(dummy_mod,    "chol2_dummyVars.rds")
saveRDS(pp_obj,       "chol2_preprocess.rds")
saveRDS(predictor_vars, "chol2_predictor_vars.rds")

```

```{r}
# -------------------------------------------------
# 10. Helper for scoring a *single* new participant
# -------------------------------------------------
predict_CHOL_2 <- function(new_record) {
  ## 10a. Load artefacts
  model   <- readRDS("bodywt_nnet_model.rds")
  dummy   <- readRDS("bodywt_dummyVars.rds")
  pp      <- readRDS("bodywt_preprocess.rds")
  
  ## 10b. Make sure factor columns have the same levels as the training data
  new_record[] <- lapply(new_record, function(x) {
    if (is.character(x)) as.factor(x) else x
  })
  new_record <- add_missing_level(new_record)   # same helper as above
  
  ## 10c. Apply the *same* preprocessing (impute → centre → scale)
  # Note: the preProcess object was built on predictor‑only data,
  # so we can feed the raw new_record straight to it.
  new_pp <- predict(pp, new_record)
  
  ## 10d. One‑hot encode the predictors
  new_enc <- predict(dummy, new_pp) %>% as.data.frame()
  
  ## 10e. Predict the outcome
  predict(model, newdata = new_enc)
}

```

Predictors: "body_weight_T1", "body_weight_T2", "longitude"

```{r}
# -------------------------------------------------
# 11. Example usage
# -------------------------------------------------
new_participant <- tibble(
  age                = 20,
  gender               = "MALE",   # must match a level seen in training
  body_weight_T1 = 83,
  longitude = 6.59
)

predicted_one <- predict_CHOL_2(new_participant)
print(predicted_one)
```
